verdict.rationale: Statsig's API reference documents multi-item calls: one request can evaluate one or more feature gates, or log one or more custom events. That is genuine batch handling, but only for evaluation and event ingestion. The Console API and CLI give CRUD and CI/CD automation but document no bulk edit, archive or update across many gates or experiments, so building that is left to the user. Missing for 10: documented bulk management operations (bulk update/archive/delete of gates and experiments), bulk actions via MCP or CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Evaluates one or more feature gates for a user and returns pass/fail results.
Logs one or more custom events for analytics and metric calculation.
